# devopser_workspace_settings (Resource)

Settings of an existing workspace (tfe_workspace_settings).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "devopser_workspace_settings" "network" {
  workspace_id        = devopser_workspace.network.id
  global_remote_state = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `global_remote_state` (Boolean) Let every workspace in the organization read this workspace's outputs. Reset to false on destroy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace id.
